From Persecution to Genocide

Write the event associated with each year. A recognized answer unlocks a historical image and explanation.

Events overlap and do not imply an inevitable progression. All 18 historical images are embedded and work offline. Captions distinguish photographs of the event from images used for historical context. Image descriptions and identifications should be checked against the original archival records before publication. Completion codes are locally generated and cannot be independently verified by Canvas or Blackboard.
